equipment.variant: All DSE7200/7300 variants covered by 057-074 Issue 13

entries.meaning: The auxiliary charge alternator voltage is low as measured from the W/L terminal.
entries.applicability: DSE7200 and DSE7300 series modules only (057-074 Issue 13). Listed in the manual under warning alarms. Not DSE7310 MKII / DSE7320 MKII.

equipment.variant: Module firmware V4 onwards (per the manual)

entries.meaning: Shutdown and electrical-trip alarms can be disabled by user configuration; the alarm text is then displayed but the engine continues to run. Check the configuration before relying on any controller shutdown.
entries.applicability: DSE7200 and DSE7300 series, firmware V4 onwards. A configuration state, not a threshold.

equipment.variant: All DSE7200/7300 variants covered by 057-074 Issue 13

entries.meaning: The engine speed has exceeded the pre-set trip. During start-up the overspeed trip logic can be configured to allow an extra margin ('Overspeed Overshoot') to prevent nuisance tripping.
entries.applicability: DSE7200 and DSE7300 series only. Listed under shutdowns; the trip value is the module configuration, not published here.

equipment.variant: Modules configured for magnetic-pickup speed sensing

entries.meaning: The speed signal from the magnetic pickup is not being received by the controller.
entries.applicability: DSE7200 and DSE7300 series with a magnetic pickup configured. Listed under shutdowns.

equipment.variant: Factory configuration; MPU or CAN by configuration

entries.meaning: Speed detection is factory configured from the main alternator output frequency; a flywheel magnetic pickup can be added by configuration; with CAN configured, speed comes over CAN. Rising oil pressure can disconnect the starter but cannot detect under- or overspeed.

equipment.variant: All DSE7200/7300 variants covered by 057-074 Issue 13

entries.parameter: Controller DC supply (troubleshooting: unit shuts down)
entries.meaning: If the unit shuts down, check the DC supply voltage is not above 35 V or below 9 V. This is the controller module's own supply check, not a battery charging limit.
entries.applicability: DSE7200 and DSE7300 series module supply only; not a battery charging or engine limit.

entries.meaning: Make sure the magnetic pickup screen connects to earth at one end only (earthed at both ends it acts as an aerial and picks up random voltages); check the pickup is the correct distance from the flywheel teeth.
entries.applicability: DSE7200 and DSE7300 series with a magnetic pickup.

gaps: The configuration listing in this copy (PDF p. 110) shows placeholders (0 rpm, 0 V, 0%) for over/under-speed, battery and charge-alternator settings: no factory defaults are published in it. Trip settings remain per controller configuration — NOT VERIFIED.
Not checked against the current DSE7310 MKII / DSE7320 MKII manual (057-253); these entries apply only to the DSE7200 / 7300 series named.
